rappel_detail.anchor: large horn thickly slung with rappel webbing, about 50 ft below the true summit
rappel_detail.station: Belay and downclimb the exposed summit ridge back to the large slung horn about 50 ft below the top, a good confirmation that you are on the descent.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, double-rope (two 60 m ropes), down the West Face to the base of the black basalt dike. Then scramble several hundred feet of Class 3 down the dike to the top of the crux dihedral.

rappel_detail.anchor: natural anchor (slung horn, block or chockstone) at the top of the crux dihedral
rappel_detail.station: The top of the crux dihedral, reached by scrambling down the dike.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, a diagonal double-rope rappel that reaches the snow finger in one go.
hazards: The last person down should place a directional piece so the rope runs true on the diagonal.
